formats: K4 Lloyd-Max or two-region Structured K8 arithmetic; V2 or V4 Lloyd-Max; existing rotation, scale, and current-token policy
placement: Early uses the lowest-numbered k layers for K8 and the lowest-numbered 28-2k for V4. DP uses the exact historical quota row for k.
cohort: All eight validation inputs from relative_kv_20261124/data_manifest.json. Score 1023 next-token targets per input using the same offline evaluator.
selection: Score every candidate on all eight documents. Rank by unrounded pooled token NLL, then prefer early_07 on an exact tie, then lexical plan ID. Freeze the validation winner.
reuse: Prior raw validation score requires matching model, scorer, runtime, deployment config, source tokens and raw score hash in the historical report.
scope: Validation selection only. 48 document scores, 8184 targets per candidate.
